ctx.x: So, well, he had been in school a couple of years, and then all of a sudden we didn't hear from him. So Uncle John says, 'Kenny, it's strange I haven't heard from Charles for about six months. What's going on?' You know, he was so busy running and delivering babies and operating and this and that, so he sort of left it up to me to keep contact with

Well, I couldn't. You know, I couldn't get word to him. So he said, 'Okay, we'll drive down one Sunday and see exactly what's going on.' So we arrived at the university and we asked around, and they said, 'Oh, Charles. Well, he left school about three months ago.' So my Uncle John said, 'Oh, no, this is impossible.' So the director, he said, 'Well, listen, there's a man came here from Clarksburg, West Virginia, and he left with him.' So we said, well, let's go to Clarksburg. So he went to Clarksburg and found…
